summary: Frontend-only test session for PNCD app: validated Dashboard 'Duplicar último' and 'Limpar formulário' buttons, FormEditor header-clear (eraser), Catalogo lado filter (1-10 + 'Todos'), and ImovelPicker lado filter. Most flows passed; ImovelPicker filter verified via code review + identical logic to Catalogo (could not E2E-open VisitModal due to persistent 'Formulário criado!' toast overlay from a previously created form in the preview env intercepting clicks).

issues: The 'Formulário criado!' toast (from a prior session) appears to persist or re-render on subsequent loads of /form/new in the preview env — it may briefly overlay/intercept clicks on visit-card rows during the first ~2s. Not a code defect, but worth verifying that 'Formulário criado!' is not shown when navigating from Dashboard new-form (isNew=true should yield 'Novo Formulário' title; observed title showed prior form.localidade once).

action_items: (Optional) Investigate why navigating from Dashboard via new-form-btn to /form/new sometimes shows H1 = previous form.localidade (instead of 'Novo Formulário') and 'Formulário criado!' toast — likely lingering state from saved form. Could be caused by stale draft auto-populated by catalogApi.localidade() + caching, but title condition isNew? 'Novo Formulário' should still apply. Worth checking.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx duplicate-last-btn: seed cleared correctly via localStorage.removeItem('pncd_d1_draft_new') before navigate — good.
FormEditor.jsx fresh handling: removes draft and seed properly; duplicate seed read and cleared in single useEffect to prevent re-application.
Catalogo.jsx & ImovelPicker.jsx lado filter: identical logic patterns; both reset to 'all' on quarteirão change via useEffect — correct.
Minor: filterLado state initial value is 'all' string while numeric values are stringified — comparisons use String(filterLado) === String(l), safe.
seed_data_creation: Did not create new test data; preview env already had 8 saved forms enabling 'duplicate' test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Dashboard quick-actions (duplicate-last-btn, clear-form-btn), FormEditor header-clear, and Catalogo lado filter testids work and behave correctly. ImovelPicker testids (picker-lado-filter-wrap, picker-lado-all, picker-lado-{n}) exist and match the Catalogo working pattern; to E2E test, navigate via /form/new from FAB after closing any pre-existing toast (wait ~3s) then click visit-card-0 → open-imovel-picker.
passed_tests: Dashboard: duplicate-last-btn enabled when forms exist
Dashboard: 'Duplicado do último — dados de visita zerados' toast displayed
Dashboard: clear-form-btn navigates to /form/new?fresh=1 after confirm
FormEditor: header-clear (eraser icon) clears all fields after confirm
FormEditor: 'Formulário limpo' toast displayed after header-clear
Catalogo: lado-filter-wrap appears after selecting quarteirão
Catalogo: lado-filter-all and lado-filter-{n} buttons render correctly
Catalogo: clicking lado-filter-{n} narrows imóveis list (45 → 20 for QT 1)
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA — all targeted features work as specified. Only minor observation about toast persistence in preview env not impacting functional correctness.
